criteria.contract: Dated personal representative observations derive only from initial scenario, local witnessed succession and personally opened signed papers; foreign live truth is not consulted and late old signatures cannot roll knowledge back
Known-address inquiry and direct current-head reconfirmation preserve the formed version and original expiry; requester receipt travels separately, without PlayerControl impersonation
Unknown foreign succession, stale addressee, lost inquiry/response, fixed-address bounded retries and duplicates preserve provenance without exposing new authority or creating a new treaty

Successive locally agreed representative changes retain old papers and personal observations; stale authority cannot answer politically and historical prefixes cannot borrow later same-second information
Focused and related tests, real generation recovery/future equality, old-save bytes, Game build and headless Node3D equality are checked; GUI/appearance are explicitly separate

limits: Dated representative observations: scenario baseline, local actual succession witnesses and personally opened signed truce/stance/contact papers only. New representative inquiry routes by the signer personal knowledge, not live foreign truth; old legacy normal-confirmation guard remains bounded as in PR34. One inquiry root per known representative pair/original acceptance, same-address resends max3 after personal failure recognition. Direct signed reconfirmation response retains original terms/expiry and fixed signer address; requester receipt is separate. NPC response copies preserve original signature/evidence and max3. Successive two-person agreed changes tested; no general foreign NPC succession, death/disputes, general treaty/alliance/hostage, player factual-report retry, GUI/appearance or full3600 execution.
